atoms.text: Migration is the movement of people from one country to another. People who migrate usually decide to live at the new location.
Immigration describes the process of moving to a new country while emigration describes the process of moving away from a home country.

instruction.text: Ordne die Begriffe den richtigen Beschreibungen zu.

atoms.a: to move from one country to another
to move away from a home country
to move to a new country

instruction.text: Fülle die Lücke, indem du die fehlende Vokabel antippst.

atoms.b: Wei-Ling's ancestors ((++migrated immigrated emigrated)) from China to Canada.
Lucía ((migrated immigrated ++emigrated)) from her home country Chile.

atoms.text: Migration has existed for nearly as long as life on earth has. Before humans existed, animals migrated over land and sea. Centuries later, ancient humans, for example, migrated from Africa to Eurasia. Creatures have always been on the move for a better life.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>century:</lang> bedeutet Jahrhundert. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>ancient humans:</lang> bedeutet Menschen der Antike.

atoms.text: There are different reasons why people choose to migrate. For example:
atoms.sound: There are different reasons why people choose to migrate. For example: climate changes, political situations, and education. Some factors make people leave their home country, while other factors attract people to a new place.

atoms.text: Some factors make people leave their home country, while other factors attract people to a new place.

instruction.text: Ordne die Begriffe der richtigen Kategorie zu.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>poverty:</lang> bedeutet Armut. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>natural hazards:</lang> bedeutet Naturkatastrophen.

atoms.text: Sometimes, people are forced to leave their homes because it is not safe for them to stay. This can happen because of war, floods, or other problems. These people are called involuntary migrants.

hint.text: to be forced to do sth. – gezwungen sein etwas zu tun
hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to be forced to do something:</lang> bedeutet gezwungen sein etwas zu tun.
